input.quote: 20.1 Vendor shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless Customer, its Affiliates, and their directors, officers, employees, and agents from each third-party claim and resulting damages, settlements, judgments, penalties, costs, and reasonable attorneys' fees arising from an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate an intellectual property right.
input.rationale: Section 20 meets the preferred position in full. § 20.1 gives an express Vendor duty to defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates against third-party claims that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate IP. § 20.2 extends the Vendor indemnity to Vendor's breach of Applicable Law, unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor, and Vendor's gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud. § 20.4 supplies the standard procedure — prompt notice, reasonable cooperation (at the indemnifying Party's expense) and control of the defence, with a Customer-protective settlement consent right. § 20.3 keeps Customer's indemnity narrow: unmodified Customer-supplied material used strictly as authorized, plus Customer's violation of Applicable Law, with carve-outs for Vendor Technology, modifications, combinations and instructions. § 20.7 (20.5) also adds procure/modify/replace/refund remedies beyond the fallback requirement, and indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims under § 21.3, so Vendor's indemnity is not squeezed by the liability cap — better than the fallback 3× super-cap. No redline required.
